name: Tiszaújváros (Hungary)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the town arms of Tiszaújváros: a red and blue shield with a yellow crown, supported by two lions, within a yellow ring inscribed TISZAÚJVÁROS.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Tiszaújváros arms with supporters in a ring
